15 GB of free storage. It recommends 16 GB of RAM and a graphics card with
4 GB. A student's laptop has 8 GB of RAM, a GPU inside the processor with
2 GB, and 50 GB of free storage.

a) Does the laptop reach the minimum or the recommended level? Give the
reason. (1 mark)
